description: Reviewed contract between LMCache and the vLLM KV-cache-spec schema it reads. Maintained by scripts/check_v41_spec_contract.py --update-contract; every member's disposition must be re-reviewed on a vLLM bump. 'required' means the member is read by name on LMCache's vLLM-facing surface (lmcache/integration/vllm, lmcache/v1/multiprocess/group_view.py, lmcache/v1/kv_layer_groups.py, lmcache/v1/gpu_connector/kv_format).

pinned_vllm.note: commit is the DeepSeek-V4.1 adaptation baseline (notes/baseline-revisions.md); lmcache_tested_nightly is the version on the github_nightly_tested_vllm pin branch and is provenance only. The field diff, not the hash, is authoritative when running against a newer vLLM.

dispositions.required: LMCache must name this member in lmcache/**/*.py; blind => gate failure.
dispositions.derived: LMCache intentionally does not read this member by name; it re-derives the value from the registered KV tensors. Blind => warning only.
dispositions.known_gap: Reviewed, still-open gap outside the current adaptation scope. Blind => warning only, kept visible on purpose.
dispositions.not_applicable_v41: Present on a V4.1-reachable class but never set/consumed on the DeepSeek-V4.1 H100/SM90 path. Blind => warning only.
dispositions.unreviewed: Not yet classified; always a gate failure.

alignment.reason: vLLM folds page alignment into page_size_padded in _apply_alignment_padding (kv_cache_interface.py:626-632); LMCache reads the padded result, and never names spec.alignment on the vLLM read surface

attention_chunk_size.reason: chunked-local attention only; DeepSeek-V4.1/H100 runs MLA + SWA + the circular-buffer ring, never ChunkedLocalAttentionSpec

block_size.reason: tokens per engine block id; the base of every LMCache block geometry

block_stride_alignment.reason: byte alignment of the distance between consecutive blocks (DeepGEMM paged sparse MQA-logits needs 512B)

block_table_token_alignment.reason: scheduler-side block-table token alignment; LMCache addresses blocks by engine block id, not through the block table

cache_dtype_str.reason: raw --kv-cache-dtype string; LMCache takes the storage dtype from the registered tensor instead

cache_role.reason: distinguishes the sparse main cache from the indexer cache inside one group

dtype.reason: storage dtype of the registered KV tensor

extra_retained_tokens.reason: multi-module spec-decoding window retention; DeepSeek-V4.1's SWA spec leaves it at 0 (sparse_swa.py get_kv_cache_spec does not pass it)

first_spec.reason: convenience accessor for a wrapper's first leaf; LMCache's _first_leaf_spec implements the same

has_layer_views.reason: worker-side view flag; LMCache builds its layer views from the registered tensors

head_size_v.reason: MLA has no separate V; the content width is re-derived from the registered tensor's last dimension (see the 132B indexer detection)

is_index_group_leader.reason: one-index-group leader flag; part of the group-role validation gate

kv_cache_specs.reason: the per-layer leaf map of a UniformTypeKVCacheSpecs group

kv_quant_mode.reason: quantisation mode enum; the effective width is re-derived from the registered tensor

model_version.reason: V4.1 always writes 'deepseek_v4'; LMCache's layout detection keys on registered tensor geometry, not on this hint

non_causal.reason: vLLM documents it as scheduling-only: 'It does not affect the KV cache layout itself' (kv_cache_interface.py:546-552)

non_causal_multi_token_decode.reason: reviewed but still unreferenced: deferred out of the phase-1 8-field EngineGroupInfo contract (docs/phase1/03-p0-groupview.md). Defaults to False on the V4.1/H100 path, so it is not a correctness risk today, but it must be picked up before any V4.1 model enables non-causal multi-token decode.

num_head_slots.reason: logical page H when it diverges from num_kv_heads

num_heads.reason: resolved logical page H (num_head_slots or num_kv_heads)

num_kv_heads.reason: LMCache takes head counts from vllm_config.model_config.get_num_kv_heads(...) and from the registered tensor geometry, not from AttentionSpec.num_kv_heads; the resolved logical H it does read is num_heads

num_states.reason: block_size // tokens_per_state; LMCache detects slots_per_block from the block tensor's batch dimension

page_size_padded.reason: padded page size; drives per-block byte geometry

prefix_cacheable.reason: filters which engine groups LMCache caches (False for the circular-buffer ring)

sliding_window.reason: SWA window size; drives hit-length validity for V4.1 SWA groups

state_content_bytes.reason: packed bytes per (head slot, state) cell; replaces the hardcoded 132B indexer heuristic

state_content_size_bytes.reason: resolved default (head_size + head_size_v) * dtype_size; re-derived from the tensor

storage_block_size.reason: storage-view token width when it differs from the kernel block

tokens_per_state.reason: renamed from compress_ratio; the compression factor LMCache must read instead of the old name

unpadded_page_size_bytes.reason: num_heads * num_states * state_content_size_bytes; re-derived from the tensor

uses_slot_mapping.reason: whether the worker computes slot mapping for this group
